description: Changed-path denominator for full-tier frontend / frontend-e2e cheap-exit (#6917). A first-step path check exits 0 when nothing here changed. Prefixes end with /; other entries are exact paths. Hardening: the hydrate-entrypoint resolver only matches plain `npm run <name>` (not `npm run -s` / `npm run --silent`) and does not expand `npx` invocations — keep hydrate scripts on the covered forms or extend the resolver before adding those.
